description: Read-only: fetch public metadata for a Rust crate from the free, unauthenticated crates.io API (https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/<name>). Returns name, latest version, description, license, repository, downloads, recent_downloads, max_version, updated_at, documentation and homepage. No login or API key.

name.description: Crate name, e.g. serde (letters, digits, - and _ only, max 64 chars)

name: get_crate_info
